units.source_text: 我是月末回到东京的，离开避暑地的时间比先生早得多。

en.t: I returned to Tokyo at the end of the month, having left the summer resort much earlier than Sensei.

units.source_text: 向先生告别的时候，我问他：“今后可以常去府上拜访吗？”

en.t: When I said goodbye to Sensei, I asked him, "May I come to visit your home from time to time after this?"

units.source_text: 先生只是简单地答道：“行啊，来吧。”

en.t: Sensei merely answered simply, "Yes, come by."

units.source_text: 那时，我自认为和先生已相当熟识，先生会说些更热情的话，

en.t: At that time, I thought I had become quite close to Sensei and expected him to say something warmer,

units.source_text: 所以这让人失望的回答多少伤了我的自信心。

en.t: so that disappointing answer wounded my self-confidence somewhat.

units.source_text: 先生常常做出这类让我失望的事。

en.t: Sensei often did things of this kind that left me disappointed.

units.source_text: 他似乎有所察觉，又好像全然不知。

en.t: He seemed to be aware of it, and yet also seemed completely unaware.

units.source_text: 我一再重复着这种轻微的失望，却没有因此而离开先生，

en.t: Though I repeatedly felt this slight disappointment, it did not make me draw away from Sensei,

units.source_text: 相反，每当我感到不安时，就更想接近先生。

en.t: on the contrary, whenever I felt uneasy, I wanted all the more to get closer to him.

units.source_text: 我想，只要我继续去了解先生，终有一天，

en.t: I thought that if I continued trying to understand Sensei, then someday,

units.source_text: 我所期待的东西会完满地出现在我眼前的。

en.t: the thing I was hoping for would fully appear before my eyes.

units.source_text: 虽说我很年轻，但我并不愿为所有的人这样热血沸腾，

en.t: Although I was young, I did not feel that my blood would run so hot for everyone,

units.source_text: 不知为什么，我只对先生一人产生了这种心情。

en.t: for some reason, I felt this way only toward Sensei.

units.source_text: 直到先生已经去世的今天，我才明白，

en.t: Only now, today, after Sensei has already passed away, do I understand

units.source_text: 先生从一开始就没有讨厌我，

en.t: that Sensei had not disliked me from the beginning,

units.source_text: 他偶尔对我表现出的看似冷淡的寒暄和举动，

en.t: and that the greetings and behavior he sometimes showed me, which appeared cold,

units.source_text: 并不是想疏远我的不快表现，

en.t: were not expressions of displeasure meant to keep me at a distance,

units.source_text: 而是内心有着创伤的先生，对于想要接近自己的人发出的警告——

en.t: but rather warnings issued by Sensei, whose heart was wounded, to those who tried to approach him:

units.source_text: 自己不值得接近，不要过来。

en.t: I am not worth approaching; do not come near me.

units.source_text: 拒绝别人亲近的先生，似乎在轻视别人之前早已轻视了自己。

en.t: Sensei, who refused the closeness of others, seems to have despised himself long before he despised anyone else.
